text: With materials or an educator's help, reads, writes and orders numbers to 1000, adds and subtracts 2-digit numbers, says the 2, 5 and 10 times tables, and finds a half or a quarter of a shape; a 3-digit calculation or a two-step problem needs support.

Alone, reads, writes, orders and rounds numbers to 1000, adds and subtracts 3-digit numbers with one exchange, recalls most facts to 10 × 10 and finds a unit fraction of an amount; slips when exchanging across a zero, when multiplying by a 1-digit number, or in the second step of a problem.

Alone and consistently, does all the outcome asks: adds and subtracts 3-digit numbers with any exchange, including across zeros; multiplies and divides by a 1-digit number; finds fractions of shapes, amounts and number lines; works with money and change; solves two-step problems, checking each answer with an estimate.

Uses the step's number work in problems not seen before, chooses the quicker method and says why, explains why a strategy works, spots an answer that cannot be right by its size or by odd and even, and finds and corrects the mistake in a worked calculation.
